item.title: Fix OpenAI “We Were Unable to Authenticate Your Payment Method”
item.description:
Payment Authentication Error

The checkout displayed:

1

We are unable to authenticate your payment method. Please choose a different method and try again.

Several cards produced the same result. The cause may involve card issuer authentication, billing details, regional availability, account risk checks, or the current network environment.

What to Check

Avoid repeated rapid attempts. Confirm that the cardholder name, billing address, and issuing region are correct, ask the issuer whether it blocked an international or recurring charge, and use official billing support when the error persists.
